bullets: AddedGPT-6 Luna and MiMo 2.6 Pro availability to all full-access Freebuff users, removing the previous US-or-paid restriction while remaining plan-only for limited-tier accounts.
FixedSponsored runs from running WSL launchers, destructive database commands, and container lifecycle commands that could touch your own system.
AddedPer-run credential declarations for sponsored runs so a reviewed procedure can request a specific third-party account credential injected into the isolated run environment.
AddedPartner ad placements with a new partner format and two reserved single-advertiser slots that are excluded from self-service targeting.
ResumedLegacy pre-multi-session hours on cross-protocol restarts so a stale hour from a dead earlier binary is detected and resumed without buying a new one.
FixedCodebuff out-of-credits 402 errors being misreported as a Freebuff provider problem, now routing paying users to the ordinary out-of-credits flow.
AddedCLI 0.0.204 release preserving session time on unexpected crashes or terminal closures so paid sessions resume instead of being recharged.
ImprovedConversation trimming to count only user-prompt turns and skip large base64 and data URLs during summarization to avoid hangs.
FixedThe fallback model display name in the session-ended banner was corrected from DeepSeek V4 Flash to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
AddedA new /model slash command replacing /reasoning with inline chat controls for model selection and thinking-level adjustment directly in the chat window.
AddedCLI fatal-crash reporting that writes a crash report to disk and sends it on the next launch as a cli.fatal_crash analytics event.
UpdatedCodebase evaluation narrowed to connected GitHub repositories only, with updated data-use text removing evaluation of non-repository code.
